# UX, Graphics, and Design System

1. Identify personas, primary journeys, content hierarchy, and success criteria.
2. Specify responsive layouts, component anatomy, interaction states, and motion boundaries.
3. Define tokens for color, typography, spacing, shape, elevation, and theming with contrast requirements.
4. Cover loading, empty, error, permission, offline/degraded, and destructive-action states.
5. Define accessibility behavior, semantic structure, keyboard paths, focus management, and reduced-motion behavior.
6. Provide an implementable graphics direction with asset constraints, alt-text guidance, and performance budgets.

Keep the output framework-agnostic until the architecture records a stack decision.
